comparison.objective: Release a loaded spring platform under control before storing its retaining bar.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous restraint and controlled release of stored spring energy; no narrow mandrel alignment, hammer strike, or fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Platform is safely unloaded and retaining bar stored; numerical motion/force limits are referenced but not present in this record.
comparison.reason: Both concern force safety, but the record tests gradual release of stored energy, whereas the candidate requires discrete contact-driven fractures plus debris containment.
